title: Remote work
text: Many companies now allow employees to work from home several days a week. Supporters say it saves commuting time and improves focus. Critics say it weakens team culture and makes onboarding new people harder.

title: Electric cars
text: Electric car sales have grown quickly in recent years. Lower running costs and falling battery prices are the main reasons. Charging infrastructure is still uneven, especially outside big cities.

title: Sleep and learning
text: Studies show that sleep helps the brain store new information. People who study and then sleep usually remember more than people who stay awake. Regular sleep schedules matter more than a single long night.
